results.content:

[...] MassAITC is pleased to issue this call for proposals through the AITC Annual National Research Award Competition. We seek pilot projects aligned with our mission of fostering research, development, and validation of AI-enhanced technologies that support healthy aging in place of choice for older adults, individuals with Alzheimer’s disease, and their caregivers. MassAITC encourages submissions from industry researchers, academic-industry partnerships, and academic teams interested in pursuing commercialization or translation of their work.

### Requests For Proposals (RFPs)

The Massachusetts Housing Partnership Fund Board (MHP) is seeking qualified third-party Feasibility Study Providers to assist residential property owners in evaluating the feasibility of constructing an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) on their property. This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) invites respondents to submit professional qualifications to be considered for inclusion on a pre-qualified list of approved FSPs. The goal of the feasibility studies is to provide property owners with a clear understanding of project scope, estimated cost, and feasibility, considering site constraints, zoning requirements, and budget.

View the ADU Incentive Program Request for Qualifications. This is the most recent version of the RFQ, updated on May 15, 2026. [...] View Answers to Submitted Questions about this RFQ.

Applications are being accepted on a rolling basis through September 30, 2026, at 5 p.m. Please email proposals to Elliot Schmiedl and Meredith Boericke with the subject line “ADU Incentive Program RFQ Response.”

## Related Resources

Didn’t find what you’re looking for? Try searching our Resources page. [...] October 14, 2026
  
Governor Maura Healey today announced a new $5 million investment to make it easier and more affordable to build Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) across Massachusetts, bringing the administration's total commitment to supporting ADU development to $15 million. The new Community ADU Pilot Program will help housing developers build more rental homes, while additional assistance for homeowners and updated regulations will make it easier and more affordable to build ADUs.

results.title: Top 10 Mobile App Development Companies (2026) — NIX United
results.content:
NIX United’s mobile app development services cover the full product lifecycle, from business analysis and technical planning to UI/UX design, engineering, quality assurance, launch, and ongoing maintenance. Its capabilities include native iOS app development using technologies such as Swift and SwiftUI, and Android app development using Kotlin and Java. For products that need to run on both platforms, the team provides cross-platform app development with Flutter and React Native. The choice of approach depends on the project’s performance requirements, feature set, budget, and long-term maintenance needs. [...] Its mobile app development services span product ideation, design, engineering, integration, testing, and ongoing management. The company offers native and cross-platform approaches, dedicated teams, staff augmentation, and project-based delivery. Its enterprise focus is especially relevant for applications that connect with ERP platforms, workflow systems, or other business software.

Intellectsoft may suit organizations that need a mobile application as part of a wider effort to modernize customer-facing services or internal operations. The company also positions AI consulting and implementation within its broader technology portfolio.

Best for: Mid-market and enterprise companies seeking mobile development combined with broader digital transformation and enterprise integration work. [...] Three factors have a particularly strong influence on the budget:

For a complex enterprise product, the budget can reach six figures or more, particularly when development includes multiple integrations, compliance requirements, and several coordinated workstreams. Ask providers to separate discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support in their estimates. This makes proposals easier to compare and reduces the risk of choosing a low initial quote that excludes essential work.
